Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the non-Taft president as Franklin D. Roosevelt. The web search results explicitly stated the band played for Theodore Roosevelt (often referred to as Teddy Roosevelt or T. Roosevelt) and William Taft. Franklin D. Roosevelt was not a president during the era of the Jenkins Orphanage Band's famous presidential performances (early 1900s). Because the Planner misidentified the president, the subsequent conclusion about the spouse (Eleanor Roosevelt instead of Edith Roosevelt) was factually wrong.
